莉莉的生活方式(Lily's Way of Living): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。
Lily thanked Sam for the honest advice. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. In fact, autumn mornings are cool.
Lily has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. The shark swims in the deep water.

On Monday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. The experience taught Lily more than any book could. Best of all, after a week of flu, her face looked pinched and pale.

People around Lily often share different ideas about the green hill. Lily keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Spring starts in March.
The forest path has become an important part of daily life. Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit.
